title: NEBULIZER THERAPY
skills: Makes a complete assessment of patient.
Explains procedure to patient/parents.
Observes standard precautions.
Places patient in a comfortable sitting/semi-fowler's position.
Carries out physician's orders appropriately.
Instructs patient to take deep breaths during nebulization.
Encourages patient to cough and expectorate secretions if applicable.
Provides health teachings to patient and family.
Documents all nursing measures rendered.
Provide oral hygiene after nebulization.
Provide adequate oral fluid with aspiration precautions
attitude: Respects patient's right and responses during any procedure.
Answers patiently and correctly patient questions regarding hospitalization.

title: OBSTETRIC EMERGENCIES
knowledge: Defines the most common obstetric emergencies with identification of the major causes.
Verbalizes clinical guidelines and recommendations for the management of shoulder dystocia, ante partum hemorrhage, post-partum hemorrhage, cord prolapse & eclampsia.
Discusses the emotional/psychological consequences for the woman and her family following an obstetric emergency.
Discusses clinical risk management in relation to obstetric emergencies & importance of debriefing sessions.
Discusses the importance of clear, comprehensive, accurate record keeping.
skills: Provides specific, culturally sensitive patient assessment and education.
Provides support and information to women and their families during and after obstetric emergencies.
Demonstrates the ability to check apparatus.
Provide age specific & culturally sensitive patient teaching to patient/family.
Provides an opportunity for the woman and her family to be counselled following an obstetric emergency.
Demonstrates using a systemic approach in the management of each obstetric emergency.
Demonstrates correct first line management of each obstetric emergency.
Demonstrates assembly of the obstetric bed to facilitate the management of obstetric emergencies.
attitude: Responds to obstetric emergencies promptly & manage situation appropriately in a calm, systematic manner.
Understands and respect patient/family response to plan of care following an obstetric emergency & addresses issues and concerns in a polite manner.

title: SHOCK
knowledge: List the structure and function of the circulatory system.
Enumerate and define different classifications of shock.
List signs and symptoms of shock.
State the steps in the emergency medical care of the patient with signs and symptoms of shock (hypo perfusion).
Discuss the primary and subsequent assessment of patients in level of priority (Airway, Breathing, and Circulation).
Discuss the primary and general interventions of resuscitation in restoring adequate tissue perfusion.
skills: Demonstrate the rapid steps of care of patients exhibiting signs and symptoms of shock.
Performs fluid resuscitation as appropriate depending on the assessment of the patient.
Demonstration of correct transfusion of blood in accordance to guidelines provided.
attitude: Confidentially identify patients exhibiting signs and symptoms of shock
Performing emergency resuscitation with respect to the dignity of the patient

title: TRIAGE
knowledge: Defines the purpose of triage and the roles of each persons involved during the process.
States the nursing responsibility regarding triage process
Identifies the tools that are utilized during triage process.
Identifies situations that require immediate attention.
skills: Performs primary survey for immediate patient screening
Utilizes the appropriate Triage system implemented in the institution.
Performs secondary survey for thorough patient screening.
Demonstrates procedures for assisting physicians.
Utilizes all associated forms and documents.
attitude: Balances and prioritizes patient needs and promotes flexibility in emergent situations.
Maintains an open, approachable manner and treats other fairy and respectfully.
Preserves privacy and confidentiality and shows regard on individuals' feelings.
